motivation: DiceCloud is excellent at calculating character sheets. Markdown is excellent at keeping campaign notes close to the rest of the vault. This plugin connects the two without pretending that a player character is a monster.
problem: Bridging the gap between complex character calculations in DiceCloud and the need for organized, localized campaign notes in Obsidian.
summary: Converts public DiceCloud v2 character sheets into structured, combat-ready Markdown notes compatible with Fantasy Statblocks and Initiative Tracker.
